import { Card, Cards } from 'fumadocs-ui/components/card';

**Purpose** — Each example walks through deploying a sample application with the settings its framework expects: build type, publish directory, port or start command. They are reference pages — nothing is imported for you.

## How an example works

Every example follows the same shape:

1. **Git provider** — point a service at the Notploy repository, branch `main`, and the build path of the example.
2. **Settings** — apply the framework's build type, publish directory, port or environment variables.
3. **Deploy**, then **generate a domain** and open it.

<Callout type="info">
Want a one-click stack instead of a walkthrough? Use a [blueprint from the gallery](/docs/templates/gallery)
— it ships the compose file and the configuration already wired up.
</Callout>

## The examples

| Example | Notable settings |
| --- | --- |
| [Next.js](/docs/templates/examples/nextjs) | Nixpacks (default). |
| [Vite React](/docs/templates/examples/vite-react) | Nixpacks, publish directory `./dist`, port `80`. |
| [Remix](/docs/templates/examples/remix) | Nixpacks (default). |
| [Nest.js](/docs/templates/examples/nestjs) | Nixpacks (default). |
| [Astro](/docs/templates/examples/astro) | Nixpacks, publish directory `./dist`, port `80`. |
| [Astro SSR](/docs/templates/examples/astro-ssr) | `NIXPACKS_START_CMD="pnpm run preview"`. |
| [Svelte](/docs/templates/examples/svelte) | Nixpacks, publish directory `./dist`, port `80`. |
| [Vue.js](/docs/templates/examples/vuejs) | Nixpacks, publish directory `./dist`, port `80`. |
| [Solid.js](/docs/templates/examples/solidjs) | Nixpacks, publish directory `./dist`, port `80`. |
| [Preact](/docs/templates/examples/preact) | Nixpacks, publish directory `./dist`, port `80`. |
| [Lit](/docs/templates/examples/lit) | Nixpacks, publish directory `./dist`, port `80`. |
| [Qwik](/docs/templates/examples/qwik) | `NIXPACKS_START_CMD="pnpm run preview"`. |
| [Tanstack](/docs/templates/examples/tanstack) | Nixpacks, port `3000`. |
| [Turborepo](/docs/templates/examples/turborepo) | Nixpacks with turbo build and start commands, port `3000`. |
| [11ty](/docs/templates/examples/11ty) | Nixpacks, publish directory `./_site`, port `80`. |
| [Deno](/docs/templates/examples/deno) | Dockerfile build type, port `8080`. |
| [HTML](/docs/templates/examples/html) | Static build type, port `80`. |
